productOverview.headline: Cost-Efficient Mapping Without Compromise
productOverview.description: The DJI Air 3S combines a dual-camera system with high wind resistance and stable mapping grids, making it a reliable choice for topographical surveys, road alignment reconnaissance, and construction monitoring.

keyFeatures.description: What makes the Air 3S a strong mid-range mapping option.

items.title: Dual-Camera System
items.description: 1-inch class ~50 MP wide-angle sensor plus ~48 MP telephoto lens.

items.title: High-Quality Video
items.description: Up to 4K 120 fps with improved low-light sensitivity.

items.title: High Wind Resistance
items.description: Stable mapping grids even in challenging field conditions.

items.description: Reliable transmission for extended survey missions.
